I'm a Computer Science & Engineering student at JECRC, Jaipur, currently holding a 9.08 CGPA — and spending most of my free time building things that don't fit in a syllabus.

My core lane is SDE work: frontend interfaces, backend services, and the SQL underneath them, with some Azure exposure on the cloud side. I like projects that force me to touch the full stack — from a database schema to the button someone actually clicks.

Outside of code, I follow geopolitics and cricket closely — turns out both are great training for reading systems under pressure.
